newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria c.bank acts to curb banks' liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria c.bank acts to curb banks' liquidity.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said on Friday it had decided to cut to 30 percent from 40 percent the amount of minimum required reserves of commercial banks that banks can use for emergency refinancing each month.

The decision was taken at an extraordinary meeting of the BNB board and went into force today, just a week after the central bank cut the amount available for emergency refinancing by another 10 percent.

A week ago the BNB cut to 40 percent from 50 percent the amount of banks' minimum reserves at the BNB available for refinancing ahead of large interest and maturity payments on government securities due at the beginning of this year.
BNB and Finance Ministry officials were not available for further details.
Preliminary Finance Ministry figures showed that the ministry has to meet around 50 billion levs in interest and maturity payments on treasury paper in January.
